scope: Authority-bound exact-asset full-q analysis-by-synthesis and v7 continual supervision on the real 27.5-second candidate
summary: The v2 contract closes prior-filled-q and asset-presence loopholes, but the real single view remains structurally unable to identify all 73 robot joints; the v7 supervisor therefore keeps all four physical gates false and emits no robot trajectory.
evidence: The real v2 preflight verifies the source video and all three frozen asset files, derives the exact 29+22+22 joint schema, and completes in 0.010749666995252483 seconds.

The evidence gate requires joint states from sensors, calibrated views, or physics and requires named, revision-pinned proposal and exact-render stacks; neither authority class is available in the current bundle.
No robot-trajectory.npz is emitted; the hash-bound v7 compiler reports 0/4 physical stages.
The v7 continual supervisor manifest is valid, rejects 5/5 evidence-spoof attacks, selects calibrated-metric-camera-bridge-v1, and does not promote a physical model.

Two supervisor validation invocations failed safely before the valid check: one used a nonexistent summarized DA3 path, and one used supervision-manifest.json instead of the emitted supervisor-manifest.json. Both produced nonzero exits and no altered scientific result.
lessons: A finite dense q tensor is not evidence unless each hidden state has an independent physical or calibrated observation authority.
Pinning an asset on disk proves renderer input provenance, not that a generated robot has that identity; held-out exact-render separation from alternative assets remains necessary.
Supervisor artifact discovery must use the emitted manifest name rather than a remembered filename.
limitations: All 12 leg joints are outside the frame and most 44 finger joints are occluded by flowers, leaving 79 per-frame camera/base plus joint parameters underconstrained.
Independent metric scale, persistent per-stem dynamic rods, and sensor or physics-solver contact forces remain absent.
No new generated video was produced, so the visible late color, local structure, finger deformation, motion blur, frozen flowers, and force closure remain unaccepted.
next_actions: Acquire synchronized full q/qdot telemetry or calibrated RGB-D/multiview evidence that observes cropped legs and occluded fingers, then run the frozen proposal and exact-render bundle across all 660 frames.
After metric camera and robot gates pass, fit persistent dynamic stem rods and fuse force-torque, tactile, or inverse-dynamics solver evidence before any physical promotion.
